jobs.title: Director - Geological Data & Database Management
jobs.description:
Start Date: ASAP

Work Model: Hybrid

Location: Downtown Toronto

(outside Union Station – TTC & GO accessible)

Dress Code: Business Casual A Great Place to Work

Who We Are

Founded in 1993, Kinross is a Canadian-based senior gold mining company with operations and projects in the United States, Brazil, Mauritania, Chile and Canada. Our focus on delivering value is based on our four core values of Putting People First, Outstanding Corporate Citizenship, High Performance Culture, and Rigorous Financial Discipline.

Mining responsibly is a priority for Kinross, and we foster a culture that makes responsible mining and operational success inseparable. Our values-based approach ensures that sustainability and our environmental, social and governance commitments are a core part of our strategy and plans for future growth. In line with our values, we also aim to build meaningful partnerships with all of our stakeholders, including communities, shareholders, employees, governments and suppliers.

Kinross maintains listings on the Toronto Stock Exchange (symbol: K) and the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: KGC).

Job Summary

The Director, Geological Data & Database Management is a senior technical leadership role accountable for designing, implementing, and governing a company-wide database management system across all exploration, project, and operating sites. This is a hands-on leadership position: the Director is responsible for maintaining and updating company standards and ensuring sites adopt/adhere to them, ensuring standardization of database software and structures across all sites, and building and managing a team of database administrators and analysts.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure standardization of the company geologic database platform across all exploration, project, and operating sites, including migration of legacy and existing site databases where required.
Maintain database standards for structure, content, and required tables at each project maturity point (Setup, Initial Drilling, Infill, Scoping, PFS, FS, and Operations), and ensure sites are equipped to meet them.
Lead selection, configuration, and lifecycle management of database software and related tools, in partnership with IT.
Ensure QA/QC protocols are implemented and auditable per internal standards.
Establish and audit data security controls across all sites: layered/restricted access by user type, edit tracking and audit trails, and automatic, regular backups including offsite storage.
Define and enforce the separation between dynamic project databases and frozen, dated resource-model databases used for reserve/resource work.
Lead systematic, scheduled reviews of database quality across all sites and drive corrective action plans ahead of each project maturity point.
Initiate and lead internal and external audits as required.
Build, lead, and develop the company database management function, including hiring and mentoring site and project database administrators and analysts.
liase with exploration management, KTS, and site geology teams to ensure database structures support geological, resource, and reserve modelling requirements.
Develop and deliver training and documented procedures for database administrators, geologists, and technical staff on data entry standards, QA/QC execution, and system use.
Maintain and continuously improve governing documentation (standards guides, database structure references.)
Report on database health, compliance, and risk to senior technical and executive leadership.

Qualifications And Skills

Education and Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Earth Sciences, Geological Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive experience in mineral exploration or mining geology, including significant experience in geological database design, administration, or data management.
5+ years in a senior or leadership role managing database systems, technical teams, or data governance programs across multiple sites or projects.
Demonstrated experience implementing or administering industry-standard geological database platforms (e.g., acQuire, Fusion, Datashed, or comparable systems) at a multi-site scale.

Technical & Leadership Skills

Deep understanding of relational database structures as applied to drill hole data (collar, survey, lithology, assay, QA/QC, geotechnical, geometallurgical, density, and related tables).
Strong knowledge of QA/QC protocols, chain-of-custody procedures, and data security/access-control best practices in a geological or mining context.
Proven ability to lead large-scale systems and change management initiatives across geographically distributed sites.
Excellent people-leadership skills, with experience building and managing teams, including remote or site-based staff and dotted-line reporting relationships.
Strong communication skills, able to translate technical database requirements for both site-level technical staff and executive leadership.
Willingness and ability to travel regularly to exploration, project, and operating sites, including remote locations.

Compensation and Total Rewards

The base salary range for this role is $180,000 to $220,000 CAD plus a target Short-Term Incentive bonus of 30%, 30% (LTI) and group benefit coverage. The hiring range reflects our targeted compensation framework for the role. The actual offer will be determined through a comprehensive evaluation of each candidate’s experience, capabilities, and potential impact, along with consideration of internal equity, team structure, and benchmark market data for similar positions. In addition to base salary, Kinross offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support employee well-being, performance, and long-term development.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We use AI-enabled tools to help sort and review applications based on job-related criteria. All hiring decisions, including who moves forward in the process, are made by a human.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Director, DataEdge Strategy & Architecture
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Job Description Summary:

The Senior Technical Director defines and drives the technical strategy across the DataEdge portfolio. In close partnership with Product Management, Engineering, Support, and executive leadership, this role aligns product roadmaps, platform investments, and architectural decisions with customer needs, business objectives, and Rocket’s strategy to become a platform company.

The DataEdge portfolio includes Rocket’s data integration, replication, synchronization, virtualization, and data intelligence solutions. It helps customers unlock enterprise data across distributed, cloud, and mainframe environments by making trusted data available where it is needed. As AI adoption accelerates, DataEdge delivers trusted, connected, and actionable information to the applications, platforms, models, agents, and intelligent business processes that power modern digital enterprises.

This role will evolve the portfolio into an integrated platform through cloud-native architecture, shared services, AI-enabled innovation, and cross-product collaboration. The Senior Technical Director will also work with peer technical leaders to shape the Data Modernization business unit’s technical strategy, identify shared opportunities, and align architecture and investment decisions across portfolios. Success requires technical leadership and the ability to build alignment and shared ownership.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Partner with Product Management to define the DataEdge platform strategy and translate business priorities into a shared, cross-product technical roadmap.
Build alignment across Product, Engineering, and Architecture, balancing product needs with DataEdge platform objectives and the shared technical direction of the Data Modernization business unit.
Work with peer technical leaders to shape the Data Modernization business unit’s technical strategy, align investments, and identify shared platform opportunities.
Drive reusable services, APIs, frameworks, and common platform capabilities while consolidating overlapping technologies.
Define cloud-native strategies for deployment, configuration, scalability, observability, security, and operational excellence.
Partner with Product and Engineering to identify, prioritize, and deliver AI platform capabilities, intelligent automation, MCP, and agentic systems that create measurable customer value and competitive differentiation.
Represent the DataEdge technology vision internally and externally. Use customer input, industry trends, analyst perspectives, emerging technologies, and competitive insight to shape strategy and investment priorities.
Shape DataEdge’s role in the broader data, analytics, and AI ecosystem through technology partnerships, industry standards, open APIs, and interoperability frameworks.
Raise engineering effectiveness across the portfolio by advancing AI-enabled development, testing, documentation, modernization, and delivery practices.
Lead architecture reviews, communicate decisions and tradeoffs, and mentor Principal Engineers, architects, and other senior technical leaders.

Required Qualifications:

12+ years of software engineering, architecture, or technical leadership experience.
Proven experience defining architecture and technology strategy across multiple enterprise products or platforms and contributing to strategy across a broader business or portfolio.
Strong expertise in LLMs, agentic systems, retrieval architectures, enterprise AI integration, responsible AI patterns, and emerging interoperability standards such as MCP.
Demonstrated delivery of AI-enabled product capabilities and adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices.
Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture, containers, Kubernetes, distributed systems, and modern software delivery.
Experience building shared platforms, services, APIs, or reusable frameworks and leading technology consolidation.
Successful partnership with Product Management on strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and investment decisions.
Demonstrated ability to work with peer senior technical leaders to shape strategy, resolve cross-portfolio tradeoffs, align technical investments, and influence without direct authority.
Demonstrated ability to shape ecosystem strategy across enterprise data, analytics, and AI, including work with customers, technology partners, industry standards, open APIs, and interoperability frameworks.
Exceptional communication and facilitation skills, including with executive leaders, with demonstrated experience mentoring Principal Engineers, architects, and other senior technical leaders.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IS, or related technical discipline.

jobs.title: Data Science Chief Expert, CX
jobs.description:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

The context engine that makes AI enterprise ready.

Anyone can build an AI agent. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As part of our Data and Applied Science team, you'll build the context engine grounded in SAP’s Business ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants.

What You'll Build

The Data and Applied Science team will build the semantic and contextual foundation of SAP's AI. While generic AI agents operate on surface-level patterns, SAP agents are accurate because they understand the real semantics of enterprise business master data, process flows, and domain relationships. You will help build and scale the layer that makes that possible. This may include the following:

Leverage deep SAP data and process understanding — including SAP data models, metadata structures, and end-to-end business process semantics across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce — to build AI and semantic data solutions using SAP master data domains, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub assets.
Design and maintain enterprise ontologies and semantic models to improve interoperability, entity consistency, and business context across SAP and non-SAP data landscapes, harmonizing sources such as Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, MES/IoT systems, and external data providers into unified semantic or analytical layers.
Work with cloud and data platforms such as Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform to support reliable AI workflows.
Translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI use cases, technical designs, and measurable business outcomes.
Design, develop, evaluate, and operationalize end-to-end machine learning and AI solutions — from data preprocessing, feature engineering, experimentation, and validation through to deployment, production handoff, lifecycle support, and continuous improvement.
Apply advanced methods across machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, data mining, optimization, and applied AI to solve enterprise-scale problems.
Develop AI capabilities — including generative AI and LLM-based solutions — using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, business process intelligence, and other structured and unstructured data assets.
Partner closely with product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams to ensure solutions are scalable, practical, and production-ready.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or related quantitative fields.
10+ years of experience to include deep expertise in machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, generative AI, and LLMs, with hands-on experience developing, evaluating, and improving models using real-world datasets — including data preprocessing, feature engineering, and experimentation — and strong analytical and mathematical modeling skills.
10+ years of experience in machine learning, data science, applied AI, AI research, knowledge engineering, or semantic data systems in industry, research labs, or advanced academic environments.
Strong Python and SQL skills, including production-grade Python development and experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn.
Demonstrated experience of deploying, shipping, and operating AI or machine learning solutions in production environments, including production handoff and lifecycle support.
Experience with big data infrastructure, data processing and transformation tools such as Databricks, and cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and customer-facing skills, with significant experience in agile development environments and a strong curiosity for exploring new AI techniques and their practical applications for SAP customers and products.
Deep working knowledge of SAP data models, metadata structures, and core business processes end-to-end, including how process semantics map to underlying business objects and datasets.
Hands-on experience with the SAP data and AI platform stack — including SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph Engine, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub — with working knowledge of SAP master data domains and Master Data Governance constructs.
Hands-on experience designing and maintaining enterprise ontologies using OWL, RDF/RDFS, SKOS, and SHACL, with proficiency in SPARQL, Cypher, and GQL, and experience evaluating trade-offs between RDF triple stores and labeled property graph databases.
Experience building entity resolution, deduplication, and identity stitching pipelines across SAP and non-SAP systems, with proven ability to harmonize data into a unified semantic layer using federation, virtualization, replication, and shared ontology mapping approaches.
Understanding data product and data mesh principles, including semantic contracts and governed self-service consumption.
Proven experience translating abstract business challenges into concrete AI solutions, delivering from concept through production deployment, production handoff, and business adoption.
Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders — including product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams — in agile software development environments and enterprise product organizations.
Experience building AI capabilities using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, or business process intelligence.

Preferred Qualification

Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector databases, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and enterprise knowledge grounding.
Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms, foundation model initiatives, shared AI services, or AI capabilities adopted across multiple product areas.
Experience with agentic AI, reasoning frameworks, planning, orchestration, tool use, or multi-agent architectures.
Ability to design upper-level and mid-level ontologies aligned with industry standards, map application-specific schemas to shared ontologies using declarative mapping standards and apply semantic interoperability frameworks and canonical business entity models across complex application landscapes.

Where You Belong

Join a collaborative, forward-thinking team defining how enterprise AI actually works on a global scale. You'll work alongside curious engineers, thoughtful product minds, and applied researchers all focused on building AI that customers can trust in the highest-stakes business processes. There's room to grow into new technical spaces, ship real impact, and shape SAP's AI future. If you value learning, real ownership, and building foundational infrastructure that matters, you'll feel at home here.

We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Join a team that designs, develops, and integrates highly complex systems within Honeywell Business Technologies. Notre raison d’être

Chez Deloitte, notre raison d’être est d’avoir une influence marquante. Nous existons pour inspirer et aider nos gens, nos organisations, nos collectivités et nos pays à prospérer en créant un avenir meilleur. Notre travail soutient une société prospère où les gens peuvent s’épanouir et saisir des occasions. Il renforce la confiance des consommateurs et des entreprises, aide les organisations à trouver des moyens créatifs de déployer des capitaux, habilite des institutions sociales et économiques justes, fiables et efficaces, et permet à nos amis, à nos familles et à nos collectivités de profiter de la qualité de vie qui accompagne un avenir durable. Étant le plus grand cabinet de services professionnels détenu et exploité à 100 % par des Canadiens dans notre pays, nous sommes fiers de travailler aux côtés de nos clients pour avoir une influence positive sur tous les Canadiens.

En incarnant notre raison d’être, nous aurons une influence marquante.

Diversifiez votre carrière au sein du Cabinet.
Tirez parti d’avantages souples, proactifs et pratiques qui favorisent une culture de bien-être et la création de liens solides.
Approfondissez vos connaissances grâce au mentorat d’experts et à du coaching au travail.

--

À quoi ressemblera votre journée type

En tant que leader fonctionnel d’Oracle EPM Planning (directeur ou directrice), vous serez responsable des initiatives de planification d’entreprise et de transformation de la fonction finance, et guiderez les clients pendant la stratégie, la mise en œuvre et l’adoption.

À Ce Titre, Vous Devrez

Superviser la prestation de bout en bout des missions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris l’étendue, le plan de travail, la gestion des risques et des problèmes (RAID), le suivi financier, la gestion de la qualité et les résultats globaux de la prestation.
Animer des ateliers d’établissement des exigences et de conception des processus, traduire les besoins d’affaires en solutions fonctionnelles, en approche de configuration et en plans de mise en œuvre.
Assumer la responsabilité de la conception de la solution et des décisions en matière d’architecture et fournir des directives à cet égard, en assurant l’harmonisation avec l’architecture d’entreprise, l’évolutivité et la maintenabilité à long terme.
Assurer la direction fonctionnelle des solutions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris Hyperion Planning et la gamme complète de modules EPBCS, en assurant l’alignement sur les objectifs du client et les pratiques exemplaires.
Guider les équipes tout au long de la conception du modèle de planification (catalyseurs, hypothèses, scénarios, flux de travail, production de rapports) et s’assurer que les décisions de conception sont adaptables et justifiables.
Aider les clients à définir des processus de planification et des modèles opérationnels futurs, en tirant parti des capacités Oracle EPM pour améliorer l’efficacité et les renseignements.
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes du client au sein des équipes des finances, des TI et de la haute direction pour favoriser la prise de décisions, résoudre les problèmes et maintenir l’alignement dans l’ensemble du programme.
Superviser les activités de test et de déploiement, notamment la stratégie de test, le tri des défectuosités, l’état de préparation aux essais d’acceptation par l’utilisateur et la planification du déploiement, afin de s’assurer que les solutions répondent aux exigences et sont adoptées avec succès.
Diriger et encadrer les membres de l’équipe de prestation de services (conseillers et conseillers principaux) afin de promouvoir une solide discipline d’exécution et leur perfectionnement grâce au coaching et à une rétroaction de qualité.
Contribuer aux efforts de développement des affaires par l’entremise d’offres de service, d’estimations, d’un soutien en matière de solutions et de présentations aux clients.
Demeurer au courant des nouveautés liées au produit Oracle EPM et intégrer les innovations pertinentes à la prestation de services, en particulier les capacités d’IA/IGR telles que la planification prédictive, Auto Predict et IPM Insights, afin d’améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions et les perspectives d’affaires.
Soutenir l’adoption de résultats propulsés par l’IA, comme des perspectives fondées sur l’IA et l’automatisation narrative, lorsque cela est possible dans l’écosystème Oracle EPM.

Le candidat retenu aura l’occasion de faire partie de notre premier cabinet de services-conseils qui travaille à la fine pointe de mises en œuvre d’Oracle Cloud. Vous travaillerez auprès d’une grande variété de clients et jouerez un rôle important dans certaines des mises en œuvre les plus stimulantes à l’échelle mondiale.

Renseignements sur l’équipe

L’équipe adopte et incarne la raison d’être du Cabinet – c’est-à-dire avoir une influence marquante –, tout en vous poussant à vous surpasser, vous-même et votre équipe, afin de trouver des solutions aux problèmes les plus importants de nos clients, de nos gens et de la société.

   Veiller au perfectionnement de gens et d’équipes hautement performantes en leur offrant des occasions stimulantes et pertinentes.
   Offrir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en maximisant les résultats et en obtenant un rendement élevé des gens, tout en favorisant la collaboration entre les services et au-delà.
   Exercer une influence positive sur les clients, les équipes et les gens en donnant l’exemple et en établissant des relations de confiance.
   Comprendre les principaux objectifs des clients et de Deloitte et aligner les gens sur ces objectifs afin de définir des priorités et une orientation appropriées

Assez parlé de nous, parlons de vous

Vous Avez Le Profil Suivant

Au moins cinq années d’expérience dans la prestation de solutions Oracle EPM Planning, notamment la mise en œuvre, la configuration et le soutien dans des environnements de consultation ou d’entreprise.
Expérience dans la supervision d’initiatives de transformation de la fonction finance et de la planification d’entreprise, avec un accent sur l’amélioration des processus de budgétisation, de prévision et de présentation de l’information.
Une solide compréhension des processus de planification financière, de budgétisation et de prévision et de la façon dont les technologies habilitantes favorisent de meilleurs résultats d’affaires.
Expérience éprouvée dans la mise en œuvre de bout en bout d’Oracle EPM Planning tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, des exigences au déploiement et à la stabilisation.
Connaissances fonctionnelles des plateformes Oracle EPM Planning, y compris les systèmes EPBCS et PBCS (et/ou Hyperion Planning) et de tous les modules associés (p. ex., Workforce Planning, Capital Planning, Project Planning, Strategic Modelling).
Expérience de la gestion des priorités et de l’exécution de la prestation (étendue, échéanciers, livrables) et de la gestion des besoins des parties prenantes concurrentes avec une attitude pragmatique et axée sur la prestation.
Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et capacité d’analyser et de résoudre des problèmes d’affaires complexes au moyen d’approches structurées.
Excellentes aptitudes pour la communication et les relations interpersonnelles, capacité de produire du contenu prêt à l’emploi et de communiquer avec les parties prenantes de haut niveau avec assurance.
Connaissances pratiques des intégrations, de l’architecture des métadonnées et des technologies connexes (p. ex., gestion des données, FDMEE, REST API) et comment ces capacités soutiennent les processus de planification de bout en bout.
Compréhension des capacités de planification propulsées par l’IA dans Oracle EPM, telles que Auto Predict et IPM Insights, capacité de les utiliser de manière responsable afin d’améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions et l’efficacité de la planification, et expérience de leur application (ou soutien de l’application).
Baccalauréat en finances, en comptabilité, en technologies de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe; une maîtrise est un atout.
Certifications Oracle EPM (p. ex. certification Oracle Cloud EPM) sont considérées comme un atout important.

Vous, et plus encore.

Évoluez au sein d’une équipe passionnée et déterminée à apprendre et à développer de nouvelles compétences. Bâtissez votre réseau et faites le plein d’expériences qui vous permettront de vous épanouir et vous mèneront vers la prochaine étape de votre carrière.

new_jobs.title: Director - Geological Data & Database Management
new_jobs.description:
Start Date: ASAP

Work Model: Hybrid

Location: Downtown Toronto

(outside Union Station – TTC & GO accessible)

Dress Code: Business Casual A Great Place to Work

Who We Are

Founded in 1993, Kinross is a Canadian-based senior gold mining company with operations and projects in the United States, Brazil, Mauritania, Chile and Canada. Our focus on delivering value is based on our four core values of Putting People First, Outstanding Corporate Citizenship, High Performance Culture, and Rigorous Financial Discipline.

Mining responsibly is a priority for Kinross, and we foster a culture that makes responsible mining and operational success inseparable. Our values-based approach ensures that sustainability and our environmental, social and governance commitments are a core part of our strategy and plans for future growth. In line with our values, we also aim to build meaningful partnerships with all of our stakeholders, including communities, shareholders, employees, governments and suppliers.

Kinross maintains listings on the Toronto Stock Exchange (symbol: K) and the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: KGC).

Job Summary

The Director, Geological Data & Database Management is a senior technical leadership role accountable for designing, implementing, and governing a company-wide database management system across all exploration, project, and operating sites. This is a hands-on leadership position: the Director is responsible for maintaining and updating company standards and ensuring sites adopt/adhere to them, ensuring standardization of database software and structures across all sites, and building and managing a team of database administrators and analysts.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure standardization of the company geologic database platform across all exploration, project, and operating sites, including migration of legacy and existing site databases where required.
Maintain database standards for structure, content, and required tables at each project maturity point (Setup, Initial Drilling, Infill, Scoping, PFS, FS, and Operations), and ensure sites are equipped to meet them.
Lead selection, configuration, and lifecycle management of database software and related tools, in partnership with IT.
Ensure QA/QC protocols are implemented and auditable per internal standards.
Establish and audit data security controls across all sites: layered/restricted access by user type, edit tracking and audit trails, and automatic, regular backups including offsite storage.
Define and enforce the separation between dynamic project databases and frozen, dated resource-model databases used for reserve/resource work.
Lead systematic, scheduled reviews of database quality across all sites and drive corrective action plans ahead of each project maturity point.
Initiate and lead internal and external audits as required.
Build, lead, and develop the company database management function, including hiring and mentoring site and project database administrators and analysts.
liase with exploration management, KTS, and site geology teams to ensure database structures support geological, resource, and reserve modelling requirements.
Develop and deliver training and documented procedures for database administrators, geologists, and technical staff on data entry standards, QA/QC execution, and system use.
Maintain and continuously improve governing documentation (standards guides, database structure references.)
Report on database health, compliance, and risk to senior technical and executive leadership.

Qualifications And Skills

Education and Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Earth Sciences, Geological Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive experience in mineral exploration or mining geology, including significant experience in geological database design, administration, or data management.
5+ years in a senior or leadership role managing database systems, technical teams, or data governance programs across multiple sites or projects.
Demonstrated experience implementing or administering industry-standard geological database platforms (e.g., acQuire, Fusion, Datashed, or comparable systems) at a multi-site scale.

Technical & Leadership Skills

Deep understanding of relational database structures as applied to drill hole data (collar, survey, lithology, assay, QA/QC, geotechnical, geometallurgical, density, and related tables).
Strong knowledge of QA/QC protocols, chain-of-custody procedures, and data security/access-control best practices in a geological or mining context.
Proven ability to lead large-scale systems and change management initiatives across geographically distributed sites.
Excellent people-leadership skills, with experience building and managing teams, including remote or site-based staff and dotted-line reporting relationships.
Strong communication skills, able to translate technical database requirements for both site-level technical staff and executive leadership.
Willingness and ability to travel regularly to exploration, project, and operating sites, including remote locations.

Compensation and Total Rewards

The base salary range for this role is $180,000 to $220,000 CAD plus a target Short-Term Incentive bonus of 30%, 30% (LTI) and group benefit coverage. The hiring range reflects our targeted compensation framework for the role. The actual offer will be determined through a comprehensive evaluation of each candidate’s experience, capabilities, and potential impact, along with consideration of internal equity, team structure, and benchmark market data for similar positions. In addition to base salary, Kinross offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support employee well-being, performance, and long-term development.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We use AI-enabled tools to help sort and review applications based on job-related criteria. All hiring decisions, including who moves forward in the process, are made by a human.

new_jobs.title: Data Science Chief Expert, CX
new_jobs.description:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

The context engine that makes AI enterprise ready.

Anyone can build an AI agent. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As part of our Data and Applied Science team, you'll build the context engine grounded in SAP’s Business ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants.

What You'll Build

The Data and Applied Science team will build the semantic and contextual foundation of SAP's AI. While generic AI agents operate on surface-level patterns, SAP agents are accurate because they understand the real semantics of enterprise business master data, process flows, and domain relationships. You will help build and scale the layer that makes that possible. This may include the following:

Leverage deep SAP data and process understanding — including SAP data models, metadata structures, and end-to-end business process semantics across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce — to build AI and semantic data solutions using SAP master data domains, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub assets.
Design and maintain enterprise ontologies and semantic models to improve interoperability, entity consistency, and business context across SAP and non-SAP data landscapes, harmonizing sources such as Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, MES/IoT systems, and external data providers into unified semantic or analytical layers.
Work with cloud and data platforms such as Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform to support reliable AI workflows.
Translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI use cases, technical designs, and measurable business outcomes.
Design, develop, evaluate, and operationalize end-to-end machine learning and AI solutions — from data preprocessing, feature engineering, experimentation, and validation through to deployment, production handoff, lifecycle support, and continuous improvement.
Apply advanced methods across machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, data mining, optimization, and applied AI to solve enterprise-scale problems.
Develop AI capabilities — including generative AI and LLM-based solutions — using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, business process intelligence, and other structured and unstructured data assets.
Partner closely with product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams to ensure solutions are scalable, practical, and production-ready.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or related quantitative fields.
10+ years of experience to include deep expertise in machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, generative AI, and LLMs, with hands-on experience developing, evaluating, and improving models using real-world datasets — including data preprocessing, feature engineering, and experimentation — and strong analytical and mathematical modeling skills.
10+ years of experience in machine learning, data science, applied AI, AI research, knowledge engineering, or semantic data systems in industry, research labs, or advanced academic environments.
Strong Python and SQL skills, including production-grade Python development and experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn.
Demonstrated experience of deploying, shipping, and operating AI or machine learning solutions in production environments, including production handoff and lifecycle support.
Experience with big data infrastructure, data processing and transformation tools such as Databricks, and cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and customer-facing skills, with significant experience in agile development environments and a strong curiosity for exploring new AI techniques and their practical applications for SAP customers and products.
Deep working knowledge of SAP data models, metadata structures, and core business processes end-to-end, including how process semantics map to underlying business objects and datasets.
Hands-on experience with the SAP data and AI platform stack — including SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph Engine, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub — with working knowledge of SAP master data domains and Master Data Governance constructs.
Hands-on experience designing and maintaining enterprise ontologies using OWL, RDF/RDFS, SKOS, and SHACL, with proficiency in SPARQL, Cypher, and GQL, and experience evaluating trade-offs between RDF triple stores and labeled property graph databases.
Experience building entity resolution, deduplication, and identity stitching pipelines across SAP and non-SAP systems, with proven ability to harmonize data into a unified semantic layer using federation, virtualization, replication, and shared ontology mapping approaches.
Understanding data product and data mesh principles, including semantic contracts and governed self-service consumption.
Proven experience translating abstract business challenges into concrete AI solutions, delivering from concept through production deployment, production handoff, and business adoption.
Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders — including product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams — in agile software development environments and enterprise product organizations.
Experience building AI capabilities using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, or business process intelligence.

Preferred Qualification

Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector databases, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and enterprise knowledge grounding.
Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms, foundation model initiatives, shared AI services, or AI capabilities adopted across multiple product areas.
Experience with agentic AI, reasoning frameworks, planning, orchestration, tool use, or multi-agent architectures.
Ability to design upper-level and mid-level ontologies aligned with industry standards, map application-specific schemas to shared ontologies using declarative mapping standards and apply semantic interoperability frameworks and canonical business entity models across complex application landscapes.

Where You Belong

Join a collaborative, forward-thinking team defining how enterprise AI actually works on a global scale. You'll work alongside curious engineers, thoughtful product minds, and applied researchers all focused on building AI that customers can trust in the highest-stakes business processes. There's room to grow into new technical spaces, ship real impact, and shape SAP's AI future. If you value learning, real ownership, and building foundational infrastructure that matters, you'll feel at home here.

#dlhiring

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. Notre raison d’être

Chez Deloitte, notre raison d’être est d’avoir une influence marquante. Nous existons pour inspirer et aider nos gens, nos organisations, nos collectivités et nos pays à prospérer en créant un avenir meilleur. Notre travail soutient une société prospère où les gens peuvent s’épanouir et saisir des occasions. Il renforce la confiance des consommateurs et des entreprises, aide les organisations à trouver des moyens créatifs de déployer des capitaux, habilite des institutions sociales et économiques justes, fiables et efficaces, et permet à nos amis, à nos familles et à nos collectivités de profiter de la qualité de vie qui accompagne un avenir durable. Étant le plus grand cabinet de services professionnels détenu et exploité à 100 % par des Canadiens dans notre pays, nous sommes fiers de travailler aux côtés de nos clients pour avoir une influence positive sur tous les Canadiens.

En incarnant notre raison d’être, nous aurons une influence marquante.

Diversifiez votre carrière au sein du Cabinet.
Tirez parti d’avantages souples, proactifs et pratiques qui favorisent une culture de bien-être et la création de liens solides.
Approfondissez vos connaissances grâce au mentorat d’experts et à du coaching au travail.

--

À quoi ressemblera votre journée type

En tant que leader fonctionnel d’Oracle EPM Planning (directeur ou directrice), vous serez responsable des initiatives de planification d’entreprise et de transformation de la fonction finance, et guiderez les clients pendant la stratégie, la mise en œuvre et l’adoption.

À Ce Titre, Vous Devrez

Superviser la prestation de bout en bout des missions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris l’étendue, le plan de travail, la gestion des risques et des problèmes (RAID), le suivi financier, la gestion de la qualité et les résultats globaux de la prestation.
Animer des ateliers d’établissement des exigences et de conception des processus, traduire les besoins d’affaires en solutions fonctionnelles, en approche de configuration et en plans de mise en œuvre.
Assumer la responsabilité de la conception de la solution et des décisions en matière d’architecture et fournir des directives à cet égard, en assurant l’harmonisation avec l’architecture d’entreprise, l’évolutivité et la maintenabilité à long terme.
Assurer la direction fonctionnelle des solutions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris Hyperion Planning et la gamme complète de modules EPBCS, en assurant l’alignement sur les objectifs du client et les pratiques exemplaires.
Guider les équipes tout au long de la conception du modèle de planification (catalyseurs, hypothèses, scénarios, flux de travail, production de rapports) et s’assurer que les décisions de conception sont adaptables et justifiables.
Aider les clients à définir des processus de planification et des modèles opérationnels futurs, en tirant parti des capacités Oracle EPM pour améliorer l’efficacité et les renseignements.
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes du client au sein des équipes des finances, des TI et de la haute direction pour favoriser la prise de décisions, résoudre les problèmes et maintenir l’alignement dans l’ensemble du programme.
Superviser les activités de test et de déploiement, notamment la stratégie de test, le tri des défectuosités, l’état de préparation aux essais d’acceptation par l’utilisateur et la planification du déploiement, afin de s’assurer que les solutions répondent aux exigences et sont adoptées avec succès.
Diriger et encadrer les membres de l’équipe de prestation de services (conseillers et conseillers principaux) afin de promouvoir une solide discipline d’exécution et leur perfectionnement grâce au coaching et à une rétroaction de qualité.
Contribuer aux efforts de développement des affaires par l’entremise d’offres de service, d’estimations, d’un soutien en matière de solutions et de présentations aux clients.
Demeurer au courant des nouveautés liées au produit Oracle EPM et intégrer les innovations pertinentes à la prestation de services, en particulier les capacités d’IA/IGR telles que la planification prédictive, Auto Predict et IPM Insights, afin d’améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions et les perspectives d’affaires.
Soutenir l’adoption de résultats propulsés par l’IA, comme des perspectives fondées sur l’IA et l’automatisation narrative, lorsque cela est possible dans l’écosystème Oracle EPM.

Le candidat retenu aura l’occasion de faire partie de notre premier cabinet de services-conseils qui travaille à la fine pointe de mises en œuvre d’Oracle Cloud. Vous travaillerez auprès d’une grande variété de clients et jouerez un rôle important dans certaines des mises en œuvre les plus stimulantes à l’échelle mondiale.

Renseignements sur l’équipe

L’équipe adopte et incarne la raison d’être du Cabinet – c’est-à-dire avoir une influence marquante –, tout en vous poussant à vous surpasser, vous-même et votre équipe, afin de trouver des solutions aux problèmes les plus importants de nos clients, de nos gens et de la société.

   Veiller au perfectionnement de gens et d’équipes hautement performantes en leur offrant des occasions stimulantes et pertinentes.
   Offrir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en maximisant les résultats et en obtenant un rendement élevé des gens, tout en favorisant la collaboration entre les services et au-delà.
   Exercer une influence positive sur les clients, les équipes et les gens en donnant l’exemple et en établissant des relations de confiance.
   Comprendre les principaux objectifs des clients et de Deloitte et aligner les gens sur ces objectifs afin de définir des priorités et une orientation appropriées

Assez parlé de nous, parlons de vous

Vous Avez Le Profil Suivant

Au moins cinq années d’expérience dans la prestation de solutions Oracle EPM Planning, notamment la mise en œuvre, la configuration et le soutien dans des environnements de consultation ou d’entreprise.
Expérience dans la supervision d’initiatives de transformation de la fonction finance et de la planification d’entreprise, avec un accent sur l’amélioration des processus de budgétisation, de prévision et de présentation de l’information.
Une solide compréhension des processus de planification financière, de budgétisation et de prévision et de la façon dont les technologies habilitantes favorisent de meilleurs résultats d’affaires.
Expérience éprouvée dans la mise en œuvre de bout en bout d’Oracle EPM Planning tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, des exigences au déploiement et à la stabilisation.
Connaissances fonctionnelles des plateformes Oracle EPM Planning, y compris les systèmes EPBCS et PBCS (et/ou Hyperion Planning) et de tous les modules associés (p. ex., Workforce Planning, Capital Planning, Project Planning, Strategic Modelling).
Expérience de la gestion des priorités et de l’exécution de la prestation (étendue, échéanciers, livrables) et de la gestion des besoins des parties prenantes concurrentes avec une attitude pragmatique et axée sur la prestation.
Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et capacité d’analyser et de résoudre des problèmes d’affaires complexes au moyen d’approches structurées.
Excellentes aptitudes pour la communication et les relations interpersonnelles, capacité de produire du contenu prêt à l’emploi et de communiquer avec les parties prenantes de haut niveau avec assurance.
Connaissances pratiques des intégrations, de l’architecture des métadonnées et des technologies connexes (p. ex., gestion des données, FDMEE, REST API) et comment ces capacités soutiennent les processus de planification de bout en bout.
Compréhension des capacités de planification propulsées par l’IA dans Oracle EPM, telles que Auto Predict et IPM Insights, capacité de les utiliser de manière responsable afin d’améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions et l’efficacité de la planification, et expérience de leur application (ou soutien de l’application).
Baccalauréat en finances, en comptabilité, en technologies de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe; une maîtrise est un atout.
Certifications Oracle EPM (p. ex. certification Oracle Cloud EPM) sont considérées comme un atout important.

Poste basé au Québec: Le bilinguisme en français et en anglais est requis pour ce poste en raison de la nature du rôle ayant des interactions avec les clients et les équipes de projet nationaux et mondiaux.

Rémunération totale

L’échelle salariale pour ce poste est de 90,000 $ à 175,000 $. Certaines personnes peuvent être admissibles à notre programme de prime. Sur le plan salarial, Deloitte se concentre sur l’équité et la compétitivité. Nous établissons régulièrement des comparaisons aux données de référence du marché établies pour divers postes, secteurs, cibles et niveaux. Notre approche est fondée sur l’importance de reconnaître les forces et les contributions uniques de chaque personne et de récompenser celle-ci pour la valeur qu’elle apporte.

La rémunération totale offerte par Deloitte s’étend bien au-delà des programmes traditionnels de rémunération et d’avantages sociaux et est conçue pour reconnaître les contributions des employés, favoriser le mieux-être personnel et soutenir la croissance du Cabinet. En plus de nos jours de congé payés réguliers, quelques exemples incluent : 4 000 $ par an pour les avantages de soutien en santé mentale, un compte de dépenses flexibles de 1 300 $, des fermetures à l'échelle de l'entreprise connues sous le nom de "Jours Deloitte", des journées dédiées à l'apprentissage (connues sous le nom de Jours de Développement et d'Innovation), des arrangements de travail flexibles et une structure de travail hybride.

Notre promesse à nos gens : Deloitte est là où vous pouvez propulsez vos ambitions.

Vous, et plus encore.

Évoluez au sein d’une équipe passionnée et déterminée à apprendre et à développer de nouvelles compétences. Bâtissez votre réseau et faites le plein d’expériences qui vous permettront de vous épanouir et vous mèneront vers la prochaine étape de votre carrière.

Vos chemins nous portent plus loin.

La diversité de vos compétences, perspectives et expériences nous rend meilleurs. Nous voulons que vous vous sentiez comme chez vous, qui que vous soyez et d’où que vous veniez. Nous vous oﬀrons des options de travail ﬂexibles et personnalisées pour répondre à vos besoins, peu importe votre mode de vie.

Devenez le leader que vous désirez être.

Certains dirigent des équipes, d’autres sont au cœur d’un changement de culture, d’autres encore bâtissent une expertise de pointe. Nous soutiendrons votre croissance en tant que leader par l’entremise d’expériences, d’occasions et de défis variés et enrichissants.

Ayez autant de carrières que vous le souhaitez.

Nous sommes en mesure de vous offrir de nouveaux rôles et de nouvelles responsabilités, et de vous aider à vous y préparer. Notre objectif est de conjuguer vos aspirations à vos compétences et à l’excellence de votre savoir-faire. Nous sommes l’endroit pour développer un réseau durable d’amis, de pairs et de mentors.

La balle est dans votre camp

Chez Deloitte, nous avons à cœur de faire des affaires de manière inclusive – cela commence par une diversité parmi les collègues de toutes les compétences! Deloitte encourage tous les candidats qualifiés qui représentent la diversité des collectivités partout au Canada à soumettre leur candidature. Cela comprend, sans s’y limiter, les personnes handicapées, les candidats des communautés autochtones et les candidats de la communauté noire qui souhaitent incarner nos valeurs, participer à la création d’une culture de
